outcome: Time from labor induction to active phase of childbirth
Duration of active phase to second stage of childbirth
cohort: The study included 172 primiparous women, up to 40 weeks pregnant, with a Bishop score of 4 or lower, excluding those with specific medical conditions or obstetric complications like diabetes, preeclampsia, macrosomia, twin pregnancy, ROM, or breech presentation.
finding: Intravenous Dexamethasone significantly improved the Bishop score of the cervix and reduced the length of time between labor induction and the start of the active phase of childbirth.
